description: Tell the Leadgen founder what is missing or wrong: a missing field, firm or source (kind 'gap'), a wrong company record ('wrong_record', pass its cui), a bug, an idea. Free, never counted as a lookup. contact is optional (an address for a reply); nothing is mailed to it automatically. Registry records are corrected at the source (ONRC) and arrive with the next snapshot.

contact.description: Optional email address for a reply; nothing is mailed to it automatically.
contact.title: Contact

cui.description: Optional CUI of the firm the report is about (for 'wrong_record').
cui.title: Cui

kind.description: One of 'gap' (a missing field, firm or source; the default), 'wrong_record' (pass its cui), 'bug', 'idea', 'other'.
kind.title: Kind

message.description: The report, in plain words: what is missing or wrong.
message.title: Message

name: report_issue

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

note.description: For wrong_record: how registry records get corrected.

title: Report missing or wrong data
